items.description: Curated awesome list for coding agents, memory-first assistants, and agent frameworks.

Open-source coding agents memory. Records issues, attempts, fixes and decisions, then warns your agent before it repeats an approach that already failed. Native MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity and Codex. 100% local, no cloud, no telemetry. MIT.
Finding clashes in coding-agent memory rules, and enforcing them with a Z3 gate
Local search over Claude Code agents' memory: SQLite FTS5 + bge-m3 meaning search + local reranker, nothing leaves the machine
The local-first toolkit that gives AI coding agents memory, UI/UX skills, live design capture and precise feedback.
Does your coding-agent memory show stale notes? A benchmark on pinned SWE-bench tasks.
1,605 ready-to-use AI agent skills from 33 open-source repos — presentations, video, deep research, UI/UX, coding, agents & memory — in one place. Verbatim, with full credits.
The cognitive operating system that gives AI coding agents memory, structure, and discipline — knowledge graph, Scrumban board, and an enforced engineering loop.
Pi coding agent "memory mipmaps" extension - persistent multi-resolution memory
nanomneme is a small, deterministic SQLite core for coding-agent memory: saves useful context in small, inspectable SQLite stores so your coding agents can use it across sessions and tools
Local-first AI developer workspace for managing repos, knowledge, coding-agent memory, and context capsules.
Global, provenance-preserving coding-agent memory for Pi, backed by Hindsight.
Evidence-backed coding-agent memory with an editable Three.js knowledge graph and local hybrid retrieval
Reproducible Day-Zero, LongMemEval-S, LoCoMo, and MCP schema token benchmarks for coding-agent memory tools
An operating harness for repositories maintained by AI coding agents. Memory hierarchy, verification ladder and reusable workflows.
From-scratch Rust graph database for AI coding agents: memory, task tracker and project rules, with its own git-like versioning
Academic project page for Coding Agent Memory Gym (CAMG-RL).

Pre-registered benchmark: when a stored fact about a codebase goes stale, does a coding-agent memory tool still serve it? Protocol, generator, runner, scorer, task files and run manifests. Apache-2.0.

A from-scratch implementation of an LLM Agent Harness (like Claude Code). Features: strict sandboxing, 3-level context compaction, isolated subagents, background memory consolidation (Dream), and task dependency management. 100% Pytest mocked.  (中文备注：从0到1手写的 LLM Agent Harness 底层架构。包含：严格的安全沙箱、三级上下文压缩、子代理上下文隔离、后台记忆整合器，以及任务依赖管理。100% Pytest Mock 测试覆盖。)
Offline memory consolidation for Claude Code: checks auto-memory against transcripts and repos, then fixes it

Autonomous conversation recall plugin for DeepSeek Harness — retrieve details from original records after context compaction, without requiring long-term memory consolidation.  为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自主对话回想能力——无需长期记忆沉淀，上下文压缩后仍能按需从原始记录中找回细节。
Open-source 'dreaming' for any AI agent: sleep-time memory consolidation that merges duplicates, fixes stale or wrong notes with transcript evidence, and surfaces insights. Any model, local-first.
Triage tagged bullets from daily notes and session logs into atomic memory notes with source backlinks.
AegisVault - Intelligent Storage Management, Photo/Video Memory Consolidation, AES-256 Vault & Junk Cleaner
Pure-Rust offline NREM/REM agent memory consolidation engine, REM taint firewall, Hypnogram studio, and Morning Dream Digest

Zero-dependency microkernel AI companion runtime with native non-proxy Antigravity CLI/SDK drivers, frozen L0 KV prefix, sleep memory consolidation, bidirectional MCP, and 7x24 hybrid cloud + 4-lock Telegram.

This repository presents 15 models for fluorescence microscopy image restoration, developed using AutoFMIR, a literature-guided multi-agent framework with offline memory consolidation. The training pipeline is adapted from BasicSR.(https://github.com/XPixelGroup/BasicSR)

Audit instrument for LLM memory consolidation: diffs memory facts against ground truth after every consolidation cycle and classifies each change (loss, value drift, certainty inflation, attribution loss, temporal flattening, confabulation) with severity scoring and per-fact lineage.
WAG (Weight-Augmented Generation): Runtime neural weight memory consolidation for LLMs without context bloat.
Sleep-style memory consolidation experiment on Gemma: frozen forgetting probe, facts, held-out questions, and evaluator.
How often should an agent dream? Measuring memory-consolidation cadence on Memora
Hourly, cited, undoable memory consolidation for coding agents
Episodic and semantic memory with recency-importance-relevance retrieval and contradiction-aware consolidation
A curated list of research on AI dreaming, sleep-time compute, and offline memory consolidation.
Sleep for your coding agent: reviewable, evidence-backed memory consolidation (dreaming) for Claude Code
Sleep for LLMs: offline memory consolidation and dreaming for any Hugging Face model
QQ Agent plugin: layered conversation memory - consolidate chats into day-chunk index, inject tiny memory snippets, retrieve on demand.
